lines:
Responsibilities: Executes model requests through Aworkit-owned contracts and performs only subordinate provider resolution within the frozen ModelResolutionPlanV1 carried by an approved envelope. The workflow route and tier are already selected; the gateway may choose among pinned eligible concrete candidates or an ordered fallback only according to that plan, recording candidates, health facts, and the exact provider/model selected.
Owned runtime state: ephemeral provider connection pools, rate-limit windows, circuit/health observations, active stream handles, and per-invocation concrete resolution. Configuration, tier mappings, and selected results remain core-owned facts.
Versioned ports and contracts: ModelCapabilityManifestV1, ModelRequestV1, ModelResolutionPlanV1, ProviderEnginePortV1, ProviderRawEventV1, and ModelDispatchEvidenceV1. A narrow RigTranslationAdapterV1 maps these stable Aworkit DTOs to one selected Rig version and back; it is replaceable or bypassable per provider, and Rig/provider-native types never leave this module or enter workflow/config/history.
Failure and degraded behavior: only a definitely-not-accepted candidate may advance to the next frozen candidate. Ambiguous acceptance, lost terminal state, unsupported modality/tool schema, exhausted limits, or rate-limit uncertainty is surfaced without silent provider fallback; open circuits degrade only affected pinned candidates.
Security and authority: obtains only declared secret slots through the lease client, sends only approved context and parameters, and cannot change tiers, add tools, select an external agent, broaden scopes, or grant approvals.
Observability, performance, and cross-platform behavior: bounded streaming, provider latency/first-token/usage/error metrics, exact opaque-evidence limits, backpressure to transports, pooled HTTPS/local IPC, and equivalent local-endpoint behavior on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
Non-responsibilities: no harness routing, Agent loop policy, retry/fallback outside the frozen provider plan, secret persistence, canonical usage/history commit, or Rig snapshot persistence.

Provider cache accounting (2026-09-18): Preserve optional provider-reported cached-input and cache-miss-input token counts through text/tool streams, terminal projections, durable model spans, auxiliary calls and approval reviews. Normalize DeepSeek prompt_cache_hit_tokens and the equivalent prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens without summing aliases; retain prompt_cache_miss_tokens independently. Missing counters remain unknown and zero remains a reported zero. Never infer historical hits or alter total token accounting. Usage extraction must not change request prompts or model dispatch timing. See docs/approval-cache-accounting.md.

data.technology: Rust Aworkit provider gateway with replaceable Rig translation port
